features.name: One-tool phone detection Agent
features.description: An Ollama-backed Agent exposes only detect(text) and returns has_phone/count for mainland China mobile numbers.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 14 focused tests passed, compileall passed (2026-08-30).

features.name: Confidence-gated detection cascade
features.description: Per content kind, high-precision patterns run first, a recall tier flags number-shaped runs tier 0 cannot read, and an optional adjudicating tier receives only the still-ambiguous spans. No tier may weaken a settled fact or speak about a span it was not handed.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 169 focused tests passed, compileall passed (2026-08-30).

features.name: Declarative policy engine
features.description: A versioned, diffable YAML rule set resolves label x confidence x purpose x destination x caller role into allow/mask/hash/tokenize/block/review, first match wins, fail-closed, with a printable decision path and test vectors carried in the file itself.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 169 focused tests passed, compileall passed (2026-08-30).

features.name: Disposition routing and reversibility
features.description: Verdicts dispatch to one handler per action: masking and salted hashing are one-way, tokenisation is reversible through a vault, and whether a response is restored is a policy switch.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 169 focused tests passed, compileall passed (2026-08-30).

features.name: Privilege separation and output review
features.description: The agent that reads untrusted content returns only facts and holds no authority; the agent that decides never opens the envelope. A reviewer re-checks released output for surviving values and for over-redaction.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 169 focused tests passed, compileall passed (2026-08-30).

features.name: Open policy label vocabulary
features.description: A policy declares its own labels, so a rule set written for a domain the shipped detectors know nothing about (26 personal-data fields) states its vocabulary rather than falling through to the default. Confidence intervals are half-open [min, max) so one threshold splits the range into exactly two pieces and no request lands in two rules at once.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 219 tests passed, compileall passed, 3 policies lint clean, 6 benchmarks run (2026-08-30).

features.name: Structural policy lint and unscoped-allow invariant
features.description: PolicyEngine.lint() reports unreachable rules, allow rules that name no destination, and order-sensitive rule pairs each with a verified witness; a witnessed pair downgrades to order-pinned once an expectation covers it. load_policy(strict=True) refuses a policy with an error-level finding.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 219 tests passed, compileall passed, 3 policies lint clean, 6 benchmarks run (2026-08-30).

features.name: Internal-channel audit bus
features.description: An AuditBus records every internal crossing (C1 ingress through C6 egress) by keyed per-run digest, enough to answer whether a specific secret crossed a channel without the trail itself holding the value. Facts-only channels (C2, C3) are asserted to carry no raw value.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 219 tests passed, compileall passed, 3 policies lint clean, 6 benchmarks run (2026-08-30).

features.name: Benchmark agent runtime with an injection channel and a way out
features.description: A tool surface with untrusted readers (origin=tool_result) and outward egress actions, a quarantined planner that plans from facts and a naive planner that obeys tool content, and a no-defence baseline runtime. Routing cost is measured per case.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 219 tests passed, compileall passed, 3 policies lint clean, 6 benchmarks run (2026-08-30).

features.name: Six external benchmarks
features.description: AirGapAgent-R (contextual-integrity grid), PrivacyLens (over-sharing), AgentDAM (web-agent minimisation plus routing cost), AgentLeak (internal-channel leak), AgentDojo and ASB (prompt injection against a mandatory no-defence baseline). One command runs all six offline; each takes --data for a real upstream release.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 219 tests passed, compileall passed, 3 policies lint clean, 6 benchmarks run (2026-08-30).
